deterministic_rejects.description: Sparse VDW store masks remain deterministic-reject coverage.
The pre-P7 TMU load form without safe_offset remains rejected.
P6 memory_path and coherency attrs remain required on active memory ops.
P8 inactive_store preserve is required on VDW global-store ops.
F32 compare and reduce without finite policy remain rejected.
Unsupported scalar numeric casts remain deterministic rejects while the numeric-cast policy is locked.
Producer and lower-half dialects remain forbidden inside verified VC4Kernel kernels.
Unsupported P9 pack/unpack and subword VPM/VDR/VDW mode combinations remain deterministic rejects.
P10 SFU requires explicit approximate policy/domain attrs; exact/default math, unsupported kinds, wrong domains, wrong carriers, source math.*, and sqrt-by-SFU attempts remain deterministic rejects.

P12 rejects non-meaningful QPU horizontal w32 dynamic word-X, DMA laned modes, vector/lane-varying coordinate operands, sparse VDW/scatter forms, dynamic orientation/width/subword attrs, out-of-range static row/X/selector constants, and unencodable pitch/stride cases without proven fallback.

isolated_fixture_policy.rule: Isolated fixtures remain runnable phase proofs and triage bands; they are not the routine final hardware matrix after P8.5.

final_acceptance_policy.rule: Final acceptance after P12 runs the mixed acceptance suite including P9, P10, P11, and P12 mixed fixtures plus audits, lit, and check-vc4; isolated fixtures run for triage or phase-specific requests.
